shuttersHintText: Configure your roller shutters, blinds and awnings here. Auto-discovery and a setup wizard are not implemented yet - enter the id, name, covering type, driver and the relevant foreign state IDs manually for now.
scanHintText: Scans connected adapter instances for foreign states with a covering-related role (level.blind, button.open.blind/button.close.blind/button.stop) and lists candidates in the log and in the "info.lastScanResult" state (expert mode) as JSON, ready to copy into the table below. Only candidates usable with the generic drivers are found so far; system-specific drivers (Homematic, KNX, Shelly, Zigbee, ...) are not implemented yet. There is no automatic import into the table yet - copy the relevant fields manually.
name: Name
areasHintText: Configure the daily opening/closing schedule per area here. Times are "HH:MM" (24h); leave empty to skip that action for that day category. Public holidays fall back to the weekend schedule unless a holiday schedule is set.
weatherHintText: Configure the foreign state IDs of your own weather station here. Any value left empty disables the protection functions that need it (an external weather-service fallback is not implemented yet).
groupsHintText: Combine multiple coverings for joint control. Member IDs are entered as a JSON array of covering IDs, e.g. ["wz_links","wz_rechts"] - a proper multi-select editor is not implemented yet.
scenesHintText: Named presets that drive one or more coverings to specific positions at once. Targets are entered as a JSON array, e.g. [{"coveringId":"wz_links","percent":100}] - a proper editor is not implemented yet.
